<RuleLanguageLinks current="javascript" languages={[{"id":"javascript","label":"JavaScript (and super languages)","href":"/linter/rules/use-while-loop-condition/javascript/"}]} />

> **caution**: This rule is part of the [nursery](/linter/#nursery) group. This means that it is experimental and the behavior can change at any time.

## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.6.4`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/useWhileLoopCondition`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule has a [**safe**](/linter/#safe-fixes) fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**information**](/reference/diagnostics#information).
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`unicorn/prefer-while-loop-condition`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/eslint-plugin-unicorn/blob/main/docs/rules/prefer-while-loop-condition.md)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"useWhileLoopCondition": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Require the condition that ends a loop to be written in the `while` statement.

A loop such as `while (true)` or `for (;;)` that starts its body with
`if (condition) { break; }` splits its stopping condition across two places.
Writing the condition in the `while` statement shows when the loop stops
without having to read its body.

The rule reports `while (true)`, `do ... while (true)`, `for (;;)`, and
`for (; true;)` loops whose body starts with an `if` statement that contains
only a `break`. The rule ignores loops that have a label, and loops that can
also be stopped by another `break` in their body.

The fix isn't offered when comments in the loop header or in the `if`
statement would be lost.

## Examples

### Invalid

```js
while (true) {
    if (!hasMore()) {
        break;
    }
    processNext();
}
```

### Valid

```js
while (hasMore()) {
    processNext();
}

while (!done) {
    processNext();
}

while (true) {
    prepare();
    if (!hasMore()) {
        break;
    }
}

while (true) {
    if (!hasMore()) {
        break;
    }
    if (cancelled) {
        break;
    }
}
```
